cves.description: GFI KerioConnect (Kerio Connect) before 10.0.9 Patch 2 contains an HTML injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject malicious markup by crafting emails whose link text contains quote characters, causing the Webmail auto-formatter to break out of the href attribute while re-processing text already inside a link. Attackers can exploit this flaw to spoof link targets or inject arbitrary HTML into the rendered message within a victim's Webmail session.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：GFI USA, LLC GFI KerioConnect
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性
problemType: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
